summary.en: Authority Level 4. Every elemental arena is available daily during the campaign. Difficulties 21 and 22 are added to the six elemental arenas, with separate unlock requirements. The benefit is expanded challenge availability; this is not an unconditional fixed-quantity gift. The event has been extended through November 13.

summary.zh: 權限4，期間內所有屬性擂台每日開放。六屬性追加難度21、22，各有解鎖條件。福利為擴大挑戰範圍，並非固定數量無條件贈禮。 活動期間延長至11月13日。
